readme:
# Weibo User Video List API

Retrieve video posts associated with a specific user profile by supplying their `uid`. You can also paginate through results using the `cursor` parameter.

## Use cases

- Browse video content posted by a specific Weibo account.
- Collect historical video post listings for creator profile analysis.
- Track multimedia posts and video feeds for target Weibo users.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/weibo/web-v2/user-video-list" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"uid": "8431518763"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uid` | string | Yes | User ID (required) |
| `cursor` | string | No | Pagination cursor, pass "0" for first request, use returned next_cursor for subsequent requests |

## Notes

- Pass "0" to `cursor` for the initial request, then use the returned next_cursor value for following pages.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Weibo Advanced Search](/apis/weibo/web-v2/advanced-search): Search Weibo posts by keyword with filters for time range, post type (hot, original, verified, media) and content type (images, video, links).
- [Weibo AI Related Search Content](/apis/weibo/web-v2/ai-related-search): Returns AI-generated content extensions for a keyword, including related questions, recommended bloggers, and reference posts.
- [Weibo AI Search](/apis/weibo/web-v2/ai-search): Returns multimodal search results and relevance scores from Weibo intelligent search for a specified keyword or topic query.
